incident: One inline HTTP helper inherited __file__='<stdin>' and computed its D as the lane parent. It attempted to save a successful empty GitHub search result to the parent's nonexistent sources directory; that save failed. It then appended one receipt line to the parent's existing outputs/http.jsonl.
handling: No attempt made to edit or remove anything outside the lane. Subsequent inline fetches use runpy.run_path with the correct script filename. This is an actual write-scope violation, not a claim of perfect compliance.
